kinds.RISK: Possible adverse consequence to inspect; not a felt emotion.
kinds.UNCERTAINTY: Missing or ambiguous information to keep visible.
kinds.DISSENT: A grounded reason to dispute or qualify a proposal.
kinds.DUTY_OF_CARE: An authorized obligation to protect affected parties or property.
kinds.HYPOTHESIS: A candidate interpretation requiring tests or limitations.
kinds.NARRATIVE_WORRY: Story or cultural perspective; not empirical evidence of experience.
kinds.SUBJECTIVE_WORRY: Only a voluntarily reported human experience, with separate consent/provenance.
kinds.NONE: Explicitly no concern assigned for this task.

relation_store_design.role_definitions: Versioned source references shared across seats; no per-seat role-definition copies.
relation_store_design.concern_vocabulary: Kinds stored once and referenced by ID.
relation_store_design.panel_instance: Only seat/role references, concern-kind references, pinned question and source bytes.
relation_store_design.immutable_sources: Keep original locator, content identity, provenance and confidentiality.
relation_store_design.derived_views: Rebuildable, explicitly stale until source version and refresh verified.
